indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX conversation_messages_page ON public.conversation_messages USING btree (conversation_id, sequence DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversation_messages_pkey ON public.conversation_messages USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversation_private_context_pkey ON public.conversation_private_context USING btree (conversation_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversation_recipe_links_pkey ON public.conversation_recipe_links USING btree (conversation_id, recipe_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversation_shares_pkey ON public.conversation_shares USING btree (conversation_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversation_turns_pkey ON public.conversation_turns USING btree (conversation_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversation_user_state_pkey ON public.conversation_user_state USING btree (user_id, conversation_id)
CREATE INDEX conversations_owner_page ON public.conversations USING btree (owner_id, updated_at DESC, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversations_pkey ON public.conversations USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX household_invites_pkey ON public.household_invites USING btree (token_hash)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX household_kitchen_events_household_id_event_key_key ON public.household_kitchen_events USING btree (household_id, event_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX household_kitchen_events_pkey ON public.household_kitchen_events USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX kitchen_events_recent ON public.household_kitchen_events USING btree (household_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX household_kitchen_preferences_pkey ON public.household_kitchen_preferences USING btree (household_id, key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX household_members_pkey ON public.household_members USING btree (household_id, user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX household_pantry_reviews_pkey ON public.household_pantry_reviews USING btree (household_id, product_name)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX household_proactive_feedback_pkey ON public.household_proactive_feedback USING btree (household_id, key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX household_proactive_queue_pkey ON public.household_proactive_queue USING btree (household_id, key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX household_records_pkey ON public.household_records USING btree (household_id, bucket, key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX household_shopping_routes_pkey ON public.household_shopping_routes USING btree (household_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX household_shopping_sessions_pkey ON public.household_shopping_sessions USING btree (id)
